title: Geopolitical Daily
email_subject: Saudi Arabia Boxed In by Sea
preheader: Both oil routes blocked, Riyadh now asks Washington for help.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Saturday, September 12, 2026 — the 3 stories that matter most today, plus 8 quick updates from around the world.

stories.story_title: Saudi Arabia Loses Both Gulf Chokepoints, Turns to Washington
stories.why_important: Saudi Arabia ships oil through two sea routes: the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb. Houthi fighters now control Bab el-Mandeb. Iran is blocking Hormuz. Saudi Arabia has no safe way to ship oil. It is now asking the US for direct military help. This raises the risk of a bigger US-Iran war.
stories.what_overlooked: News focuses on Houthi battle wins but ignores how fast Saudi Arabia's oil lifeline is closing.
stories.prediction: Watch for a US Navy escort announcement or new Saudi-US defense talks within days.

stories.story_title: Putin Warns European Troops in Ukraine Would Mean War With Russia
stories.why_important: Putin said sending European troops to Ukraine would count as war against Russia. He claimed Europe made up a fake threat from Moscow. This warning comes as some European governments consider sending forces to back a future ceasefire.
stories.what_overlooked: State media leaves out that Europe's troop talk is a direct response to Russia's own military buildup near NATO borders.
stories.prediction: Watch whether France, the UK, or other European states announce or drop Ukraine deployment plans this week.

stories.story_title: Zelensky Says He'd Meet Putin at G20 Miami as Russia Rejoins Talks
stories.why_important: Zelensky said he is willing to meet Putin in person at the December G20 summit in Miami. Separately, a Russian official will attend a G20 energy meeting in Houston next week. This is the biggest diplomatic opening in months, even though the war continues.
stories.what_overlooked: A meeting offer is not a ceasefire. Past Zelensky-Putin offers have fallen apart quickly with no real follow-through.
stories.prediction: Watch for the Kremlin's response to Zelensky's offer and confirmation of Russia's Houston attendance.
